entity_type.description: One of: agent_insights_issue, experiment, project, prompt, prompt_version, test_suite, test_suite_item, thread, trace.
entity_type.title: Entity Type

from_date.description: agent_insights_issue only: start of the aggregation window as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit both dates for all-time counts, which is what the Diagnostics page shows. Ignored for other entity types.
from_date.title: From Date

name.description: Optional substring filter on entity name. Supported for project, experiment, prompt, test_suite; ignored for sub-collections.
name.title: Name

project_id.description: Parent project UUID for project-scoped lists (trace, thread, agent_insights_issue). Pass this OR project_name.
project_id.title: Project Id

project_name.description: Parent project name — alternative to project_id for project-scoped lists, so you don't need to resolve the UUID first.
project_name.title: Project Name

prompt_id.description: Required when listing prompt_versions. UUID of the prompt.
prompt_id.title: Prompt Id

status.description: agent_insights_issue only: which Diagnostics issues to list. Defaults to 'open' (what is broken now); 'resolved' and 'closed' show issues already dealt with. Ignored for other entity types.
status.title: Status

test_suite_id.description: Required when listing test_suite_items. UUID of the suite.
test_suite_id.title: Test Suite Id

to_date.description: agent_insights_issue only: end of the aggregation window as an ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD), inclusive. Defaults to today. Ignored for other entity types.
to_date.title: To Date
